sloka: वायसेन च तेनैव सततं बाध्यमानया ।बोधितः किल देव्या त्वं सुखसुप्तः परन्तप ।। ५.६७.६ ।।।।
transliteration: vāyasena ca tenaiva satataṁ bādhyamānayā ।bodhitaḥ kila devyā tvaṁ sukhasuptaḥ parantapa ।। 5.67.6 ।।।।

translations.english: "O scorcher of enemies pained by the crow hurting her repeatedly, while you were sleeping happily, she woke you up and informed you about it.
